response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS baseline FROM Order_Items) SELECT o.order_id, o.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_qty - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM o CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.avg_qty - b.baseline IS NULL), o.avg_qty - b.baseline DESC, o.order_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but holds numeric values, so it is cast to REAL before averaging. NULLs are ignored by AVG.
Orders whose quantities are all NULL are still listed, with NULL average and NULL difference, and sorted last. Ties in the difference are broken by order_id ascending.
